note: Local A1 word list for learner-visible Dutch in A1 batches from 075 onward (titles, situations, texts, scripts, questions, options, explanations, prompts, criteria, models, alts). It is our own editorial choice of very common everyday words, not an official CEFR list. Inflected forms are matched by scripts/a1-vocabulary.ts (plurals, -e adjectives, present-tense verb forms, diminutives). Compounds count as new words and must be listed. Authors do not edit this file; they report a needed word to the coordinator, who adds it only when it is an everyday word a beginner meets in the first weeks.
decided: 2026-10-28: the user found the first A1 bank too hard, including some words. This list is the gate for the rewrite and expansion.
